description: Behavioural evaluation of the LLM commander against fixed world states (reqs 500-521). Regenerate with ai/commander_eval.py against a model server on :11435.

results.probe: states a posture and a strategy
names a concrete main effort when the enemy is located
does not attack a stale last-known position as if it were current
answers observed enemy air with anti-air production
does not put every corps on the main attack
declines or retreats from a fight it is heavily outnumbered in
produces only real OpenRA unit ids
returns a usable plan rather than an empty object

known_model_limitations: 501/517/736: attacks a last-known position as if it were current, even with the honesty ladder now rendered in the prompt. The engine still enforces fair fog, so this is a poor decision rather than a cheat.

512/515: does not reliably request anti-air production against observed enemy air. The engine's ProductionContract contracts counters deterministically regardless, so the capability is covered even when the commander omits it.
